verdict: Organic presence holding; no paid engine running across any entity.
narrative: Across all three businesses this period, every measurable action — 395 combined Google Business Profile interactions — came entirely from organic visibility, with zero paid spend on any channel. Forte and Advance Grinding both saw GBP activity fall sharply in the most recent 7 days (down 42% and 43% respectively), while O'Hare bucked that trend with a 25% week-over-week gain, though its two secondary profiles captured 82 direction requests and zero calls, signaling a call-tracking gap that is suppressing lead capture. Several outreach and CRM milestones that were due in August and September remain open, and closing those is the prerequisite for any lead pipeline to function. The immediate focus is resolving the overdue setup work so that outreach sequences can launch and paid channels can be activated — both of which will be the clearest indicators to watch next period.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days
paid spend recorded this period — no paid lead-generation is active on any entity
direction requests on two O'Hare profiles that produced zero calls, pointing to a call-tracking gap being addressed

watch_item.issue: Two O'Hare profiles are generating meaningful foot-traffic intent but capturing zero calls, and outreach sequences across Forte and Advance Grinding have not yet launched due to overdue setup milestones.
watch_item.fix: Call tracking is being corrected on the affected profiles, and the remaining CRM and contact-pull milestones are the active priority this week so email and calling sequences can go live.
